settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure appearance and how proxies are checked.

sections.appearanceDescription: Theme, interface language, and proxy card layout.
sections.systemDescription: Background behavior and quick access from the notification area.
sections.checkingDescription: Connection timeout and optional target domains for additional availability tests.
sections.autoCheckDescription: Periodically re-check proxies in the background using your check settings.
sections.backupDescription: Back up or restore your full ProxyChecker data, or exchange proxy lists in CSV, JSON, and TXT formats.
sections.syncDescription: Sync proxies and settings through a remote provider. Uses the same backup format as local export.
sections.dangerZoneDescription: Clear proxy data or restore default application settings.

settings.proxyDragEnabledHint: Allow moving proxies between groups by dragging cards in the list.
settings.trayEnabledHint: Keep ProxyChecker in the tray when the window is closed. Right-click the tray icon for favorite proxies and app actions.
settings.startMinimizedHint: Launch the app hidden in the system tray instead of opening the window.
settings.backgroundCheckNotificationsHint: Show check results as system notifications when the window is minimized or hidden.
settings.autoCheckEnabledHint: Automatically re-check proxies on a schedule without manual action.
settings.autoCheckIntervalHint: How often auto-check runs. Uses the same timeout and check mode from this page.
settings.autoCheckScopeHint: Choose whether auto-check covers all enabled proxies, favorites only, or selected groups.
settings.autoCheckGroupsEmpty: No groups yet. Create groups on the proxy list to use this option.
settings.autoCheckNoFavorites: No favorite proxies yet. Auto-check will skip until you add favorites.
settings.autoCheckNoGroupsSelected: Select at least one group for auto-check to run.
settings.autoCheckNotificationsHint: Show a summary toast or system notification when a scheduled check finishes.
settings.checkTimeoutHint: Maximum wait time for each proxy check. Increase for slow proxies.
settings.checkAllModeHint: How proxies are checked when using "Check all".
settings.checkAllConcurrencyHint: Maximum number of proxies checked at the same time in parallel mode.
settings.domainCheckConcurrencyHint: How many enabled check domains are tested at the same time for each proxy.
settings.fetchExternalIpHint: When enabled, the checker requests the proxy's public IP after domain checks. Disable to skip this extra request.
settings.checkDomainsHint: Optional. Proxies are also tested against enabled domains. Toggle domains on or off without removing them. When at least one domain is enabled, a proxy is considered alive if any enabled domain responds. Prefer reliable targets such as example.com or httpbin.org; google.com often blocks proxy traffic.
settings.checkDomainsEmpty: No domains configured. Proxies are checked by address reachability only.
settings.checkDomainsAllDisabled: All domains are disabled. Proxies are checked by address reachability only.
settings.domainRequired: At least one check domain is required
settings.domainDuplicate: This domain is already in the list

backup.nativeDescription: Full export of proxies, groups, favorites, and app settings. Supports optional password encryption.
backup.listFormatsDescription: Import or export proxy connection data only — without groups, favorites, or app settings.
backup.importModeMergeHint: Add new proxies and groups while keeping existing entries. Settings are merged on top of current values.
backup.importModeReplaceHint: Overwrite current data for the imported backup type.
backup.importHint: Choose a backup file to review its contents before importing.
backup.previewDescription: Review the backup contents before confirming the import.
backup.importSelectProxiesHint: Choose which proxies from this file to import.
backup.importLimitHint: Imports the first proxies from the file in order. Duplicates already in the app are skipped.
backup.securityWarning: Unprotected backup files contain proxy credentials in plain text. Enable password protection when exporting, or store plain files securely.
backup.formatHint: Files use the versioned ProxyChecker JSON format (.pcbackup.json). Version 2 supports optional password encryption.
backup.protectWithPasswordHint: Encrypts proxies and settings inside the file. You will need this password to import the backup.
backup.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {{min}} characters
backup.encryptedHint: This backup is password-protected. Enter the password to preview and import its contents.
backup.previewDescriptionEncrypted: This backup is encrypted. Unlock it to review proxies, groups, and settings before importing.
backup.exportSelectDescription: Choose which proxies to include in the backup file.
backup.exportSelectDescriptionFull: Choose which proxies to include. All app settings will be exported too.
backup.exportNoProxies: Add proxies before exporting a proxy backup.

errors.invalid_payload: Backup file is incomplete or corrupted

csv.formatHint: CSV files contain proxy connection details and metadata only. Credentials are not included.
csv.formatDescription: CSV format: host,port,protocol,anonymity,https,country,city — one proxy per line with an optional header row.
csv.importHint: Choose a CSV file to review proxies before importing.
csv.exportNoProxies: Add proxies before exporting a CSV list.
csv.previewDescription: Review proxies from the CSV file and optionally assign them to a group before importing.
csv.importGroupHint: Optional. All imported proxies will be placed in the selected group.

errors.no_valid_entries: No valid proxy entries found in CSV file

json.formatHint: JSON files contain proxy connection details and metadata. Credentials are not included unless present in the proxy URL field.
json.formatDescription: JSON format: an array of objects with proxy, protocol, ip, port, anonymity, and geolocation fields.
json.importHint: Choose a JSON file to review proxies before importing.
json.exportNoProxies: Add proxies before exporting a JSON list.
json.previewDescription: Review proxies from the JSON file and optionally assign them to a group before importing.
json.importGroupHint: Optional. All imported proxies will be placed in the selected group.

errors.no_valid_entries: No valid proxy entries found in JSON file

txt.formatHint: TXT files contain one proxy address per line. Supported formats: host:port, protocol://host:port, and user:pass@host:port.
txt.formatDescription: TXT format: one proxy per line as host:port or a full proxy URL.
txt.importHint: Choose a TXT file to review proxies before importing.
txt.exportNoProxies: Add proxies before exporting a TXT list.
txt.previewDescription: Review proxies from the TXT file and optionally assign them to a group before importing.
txt.importGroupHint: Optional. All imported proxies will be placed in the selected group.

errors.no_valid_entries: No valid proxy entries found in TXT file

sync.passwordSaved: Encryption password is saved for automatic sync.
